coverage.summary: Applies to most residential rentals, including mobile homes. Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are exempt unless the tenant requests coverage in writing.
coverage.owner_conditions: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are exempt. The tenant may make the law apply 30 days after sending a written request to the landlord.
coverage.other_conditions: The deposit-account section does not apply to seasonal rentals, meaning a term of not more than 125 consecutive days.

result.notes: I removed landlord_size_condition. The 10-unit threshold in D067 only changes where the landlord may deposit the funds, which is landlord conduct. It does not decide which buildings or units the law covers. The original wording also overlapped ("ten or fewer" against "10 or more"), which repeats an inconsistency in the guide's own text. The seasonal carve-out applies only to the deposit-account section, so I kept it as a partial exemption in other_conditions. All other coverage fields are unsupported by the documents and remain null.
